intro.fr: Recovery, romhack de Super Metroid de MetroidNerd9001, a son randomizer, réalisé par ironrusty (randorandy).
intro.en: Recovery, a Super Metroid romhack by MetroidNerd9001, has its randomizer, made by ironrusty (randorandy).

text.fr: En mai 2023, ironrusty publie un randomizer de Recovery, sans protection contre certains blocages.
text.en: In May 2023, ironrusty releases a Recovery randomizer, with no softlock protection for some items.
